   **5+. TypeScript conversion** (decided 21 October 2026). The whole game moves from C# on Blazor WebAssembly to TypeScript, as the stack table says. Before item 6, in order: the docs and preview pass (spec: `docs/prompts/DOCS-AND-PREVIEW.md`); the conversion (spec: `docs/CONVERSION-PLAN.md`); the fix pass for the "Found during the port" list in `docs/BUILD-PROGRESS.md`; then item 6. The fix pass also takes what the first live game found: schemas cut down to compile and checked at startup ("One source for model schemas"), fallbacks that are never silent, and the viewer's labels for who wrote each message, with the message trail in four parts ("Who wrote it" and "The message trail" under Spectator mode). Once parity passes, the TypeScript build goes into `develop` and the switch-over pull request goes to Haakon like any milestone PR; `main` switches whenever he merges, and the build never waits for him.
